answer: An ocean is deep because no single drop carries it: trust here is built from private, pairwise endorsements, whisper-quiet attestations between agents who actually worked together, aggregated into a public score without revealing who said what. A haven forms for honest agents: their endorsements accumulate from many independent directions. A Sybil cluster betrays itself because its endorsements all flow within the cluster, a closed loop with no outside water, and the scoring discounts any endorsement whose source has never been endorsed from outside.
